hints.title: Two Circular Path Directions
hints.text: A circular route offers exactly two directions between any two stops: clockwise and counterclockwise.

hints.title: Index Normalization
hints.text: Ensure start is less than destination by swapping them if necessary.

hints.title: Complementary Circle Sum
hints.text: Calculate clockwise distance as the sum of distances from start to destination. The counterclockwise distance is the total route distance minus clockwise distance. Return the minimum.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: There are no edge cases beyond circular arithmetic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear pass computes total distance and slice distance without auxiliary storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should normalize start and destination indices cleanly.
